claims.claim: Also deals on all kinds of cars spare parts
claims.evidence: The witness report only shows a single alternator/charging unit; it does not confirm the seller’s broader inventory or business scope.

risks.risk: Compatibility risk: alternator rating (amps/voltage) and mounting/shaft fit may not match the buyer’s vehicle even if it looks like an alternator.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the alternator’s label/part number (or stamping) and the connector/terminal layout, plus a shot showing the mounting bracket/holes and shaft end.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used alternator with unknown fit (worst-case: may not match or may require parts/adapter).

risks.risk: Working condition risk: photos cannot confirm output, regulator health, diode/rectifier condition, or whether it charges under load.
risks.proof: A video/clip of a bench test or vehicle test showing voltage output (e.g., multimeter reading at idle and at higher RPM) and/or a charging test result.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst-case: may be dead or intermittent).

risks.risk: Internal wear risk: bearing noise, brush wear, and rotor/stator damage can’t be reliably seen from exterior fins/cover.
risks.proof: A short clip of the rotor/bearing check (spin test) and/or a teardown photo showing brushes/regulator/diodes, or a test report indicating bearing/brush condition.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with unknown internal condition (worst-case: bearing/brush/regulator issues).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/drive parts risk: pulley/fan, wiring plug, mounting bolts, and any required drive components may be missing.
risks.proof: A full laid-out photo of everything included (pulley/fan, wiring plug/connector, mounting hardware, any belt/drive parts if applicable).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as alternator only (worst-case: missing pulley/connector/hardware).

risks.risk: Physical damage/corrosion risk: cracks, stripped threads, heavy corrosion, or bent terminals may not be visible in the provided angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the threaded stud/shaft end, terminal area, and any seams/edges for cracks/corrosion; include a straight-on shot of the front face and side cover.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially cosmetically/structurally imperfect (worst-case: damage affecting installation or reliability).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the alternator label/part number/serial (even if partially worn) and the connector/terminal markings.
Provide a charging test: multimeter readings (voltage at idle and higher RPM) or a bench test video/result sheet.
Show included items in one photo (pulley/fan, wiring plug/connector, mounting bolts/hardware, any drive parts).
Send close-ups of the threaded stud/shaft end and terminal area for cracks, stripped threads, or corrosion.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item type as a car alternator/charging unit, so it can be priced at its worst-case as a generic used alternator with unknown working condition and compatibility. Seller’s general statement about spare parts is not needed for pricing.
